# BackEnd Service Skill

## When to Execute
Use when creating or editing API service clients in `src/services/`.

## Step-by-Step Execution
1. Import environment endpoints from `src/config/runtimeenv.ts`.
2. Define HTTP request and response types in `src/types/`.
3. Implement service methods in `src/services/` with try-catch block wrapping.
4. Validate incoming payload data against `src/schemas/`.
5. Return clean, fully-typed TypeScript service code.
